name: Kimi Code
description: Kimi Code membership access for programming workflows. Uses a membership API key and the separate coding endpoint, not Moonshot Platform billing. Model access, context limits and quota depend on your plan. Agent runtime support requires a compatible Apteva Core.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Kimi Code membership API key
credential_fields.description: Create a membership key at https://www.kimi.com/code/console. This is separate from a Moonshot Platform API key. Programming workflows only.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Create a coding-focused Kimi Code chat completion using an explicit model from list_models. Preserve assistant reasoning_content and tool_calls when continuing after tool results. Non-streaming integration tool; model and thinking capabilities depend on membership. Omit reasoning_effort for models without adjustable effort.

model.description: Exact model ID available to this membership key. Discover with list_models; no model or subscription-tier fallback is applied.

messages.description: OpenAI-compatible history, including reasoning_content on assistant tool-call messages and tool_call_id on tool results.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget; reasoning tokens may share this budget.

reasoning_effort.description: Use only when supported by the selected model. K3.1 Pro requires thinking; highspeed aliases may not support adjustable effort.

tools.description: Function definitions in OpenAI tools format.

response_format.description: Structured output only when supported by the selected model.

stream.description: This integration tool returns a complete JSON response.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Read the models available to this membership key, including account-specific context_length, display_name and reasoning/image/video flags. Does not run inference.
